code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is also mild hypocalcemia, hyperchloremia, and prolonged INR. These findings may indicate an ongoing inflammatory or infectious process, possible bone marrow suppression, and impaired oxygenation. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended to clarify the underlying cause and assess for possible respiratory or hematologic disorders.
